# `breakable` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "breakable" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/breakable/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (debug tools and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, design intent), for owner review. |
| `resistances` | object | `{}` | Share of each kind of hit the structure ignores, 0 (none) … 1 (immune); a kind left out is 0. |
| `resistances.blunt` | number 0–1 | — | Share of blunt damage ignored. |
| `resistances.slash` | number 0–1 | — | Share of slash damage ignored. |
| `resistances.pierce` | number 0–1 | — | Share of pierce damage ignored. |
| `resistances.force` | number 0–1 | — | Share of a shove (force) ignored. |
| `debris` | object | required | Debris a break leaves, made of the broken thing’s material (budgeted by the sim). |
| `debris.count` | integer 0–16 | required | Pieces of debris a break leaves. |
| `debris.size` | number > 0 ≤ 1 | required | Edge of each piece, metres. |
| `breakLoudness` | number 0–140 | required | Noise of the break 1 m away, dB (stealth and AI hearing). |
| `crack` | boolean | `false` | Telegraphs a weak spot: the renderer draws cracks on it so a player can spot it. |
